technique_name: Explain why the Internet is an important tool for learning.
description: The Internet has become an immensely important tool for learning. It provides an easy and convenient way to access information that would otherwise be hard to obtain. It also provides a platform for diverse mediums of learning through videos, podcasts, articles, and interactive courses. This allows learners to enjoy a variety of learning styles and to develop the skills they need to become well-rounded, educated individuals.
